'''Undersecretary to the Assistant Secretary to the Acting Chief of Information for Senator Wren''' was a title held by [[Horil Damlo]], a minor functionary who worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Damlo often abbreviated the title to UttASttACoIfSW, which he pronounced ''Oo-tass-tuh-koyf-swuh''. He was told that this acronym was, in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], the word for leader. However, this was untrue and the acronym was more close to the Shyriiwook word for [[tree slug]]. The title essentially meant that his job was to sit by a door and occasionally run some errands.
